notes: Searched: 'GM 9420202', '9420202 nut', 'GM 11502631 nut'. 72 AIM uses 9420202 for rear CORVETTE letters (PAL/acorn-style nut); 1981 GM P&A catalog lists it as 'NUT RR FDR PEAK MLDG' (metal). GM 87B Parts History (Nov 1990): 9420202 use 4488535 / use 11502631 (no size found for those). A CorvetteForum post gives NOS emblem nut dims '3/8 high, 7/16 hex base, 3/32 hole' but it is not clear those dims are for 9420202 rather than 446617/446618, so not recorded.

sources.title: C3 Corvette Letters PAL Acorn Nuts - CorvetteForum
sources.quote: The '72 AIM cites part number 9420202 for the rear letters; gas door is 446618 (which is probably the same nut as the 446617 below).
